led_count.evidence: Three red LEDs are clearly visible in a vertical column on the right side of the breadboard.

resistor_count.evidence: Three resistors with colored bands are visible, each connected in series with one of the three LEDs.

led_polarity.evidence: The orientation of the LED legs (anode/cathode) is obscured by the components and wiring density.

photoresistor.evidence: A small component with a snake-like pattern is visible on the right side of the breadboard.

photo_pin.evidence: A green wire connects the photoresistor circuit to the A0 pin on the Arduino.

gnd_other_end.evidence: The black wire from the GND pin connects to the negative power rail on the breadboard.
